snippet.title: Construction Simulator - Official Trailer
snippet.description: Put on your hard hat and lay down some concrete for Construction Simulator for the PC. From Astragon and published by Excalibur Publishing. Drive and operate a fleet of vehicles ranging from diggers, fork lift trucks, cranes and cement spreaders.  Out 17th of February 2012 for PC.
